rows.notes: Consumer: collision_bsp.c collision_surface_polygon (edge/vertex walk), unmodified CE TU #included by tests/c4_parity_ranges_c_collision_main.c. Vertex point (real_point3d, 12 bytes) varied per axis and per vertex; polygon points match an independent square oracle. Owner collision_bsp.vertices (82/82 retail). Not separately exercised: breakable_surfaces.c:470, ai/path.c and path_smoothing.c vertex readers (same member, other consumers; no fixture in this lane). Ledger disposition consumed is confirmed for the collision_bsp.c consumer.

plane_designator (long at 0x0) drives collision_surface_area (collision_bsp.c:705-800, sign-aware via bsp3d_get_plane_from_designator) and collision_surface_project_point2d (collision_bsp.c:802-820). Area: positive part of 2*n_k for plane 0, negated by the sign bit, plane index 1 chosen by index; matches oracle. FINDING: project_point2d masks LONG_MAX and never applies the sign bit, so the sign bit changes area but not the projection; ledger wording 'sign bit = negated' holds for area only. Owner collision_bsp.surfaces (82/82).

Bytes 8 (flags, bit 3 = breakable) and 9 (breakable_surface_index) of collision_surface (struct size 0xC; material_index short sits at 10, outside this range). collision_surface_test_point (collision_bsp.c:1544-1580) gates on bit 3 and the index against the breakable count; ai/path.c surface_is_broken (path.c:632-660, spliced verbatim) reads the index at path.c:654 with the breakable flag word. Both match oracles; index beyond the breakable count is not gated (CE behaviour). Not exercised here: collision_bsp.c:1404-1407 sphere gate (same pattern), path_smoothing.c:153-154 surface_is_walkable, path_structure_bsp.c:148-183/422, breakable_surfaces.c:434/555. Owner collision_bsp.surfaces (82/82).

bsp2d_node plane (real_plane2d, 12 bytes) and child_indices (2 longs) read by bsp2d.c bsp2d_test_point (unmodified, #included) through collision_leaf_test_vector. Plane normal rotation, plane offset and child swap each change the selected surface; matches independent 2D walk oracle. Owner collision_bsp.bsp2d.nodes (80/82 retail; the synthetic node is the nonempty fixture).

plane_designator (sign bit = projection side, low bits = bsp3d plane index) and root_index read by collision_leaf_test_vector (collision_bsp.c:1821-1900). Sign bit swaps the projected axes and changes the surface; a foreign plane index is passed over; a root that is a surface bypasses the 2D nodes. Owner collision_bsp.bsp2d_references (82/82).

Two members. bsp2d_reference_count and first_bsp2d_reference_index (offsets 2 and 4) are consumed by collision_bsp_valid_leaf (collision_bsp.c:1322-1345) and collision_leaf_test_vector; span validity and reference selection match oracle (invalid span not walked). flags (word, offset 0) IS READ by collision_bsp_test_vector_recursive at collision_bsp.c:2216-2224 (TEST_FLAG(...)->flags, _collision_leaf_contains_two_sided_bit selects semi-empty vs empty contents, which decides whether the leaf's surfaces are tested). FINDING: the ledger's preserved-opaque disposition for collision_leaf.flags rests on a scoped grep for 'leaf->flags' that missed the ')->flags' accessor form; the disposition should be consumed. This pass covers the member fixture only; the ledger correction is not made here. Owner collision_bsp.leaves (82/82).

children[2] (offset 4, two longs) read by bsp3d.c bsp3d_test_point (unmodified, #included). Child swap, leaf-vs-NONE and out-of-range node children match oracle. Owner collision_bsp.bsp3d.nodes (82/82); the single-node synthetic tree is the nonempty fixture.
